filterBasis: Regions whose catalogued distance is a maser parallax are left out: the maser layer draws those parallaxes from Reid et al. (2019).

frame.converter: Astropy SkyCoord Galactic to ICRS, heliocentric Cartesian

meaning: HII regions of the WISE catalogue with a published distance (Dist, column 13), resolved between the near and far kinematic distances by HI absorption, H2CO and other methods: star-forming regions of the young disc on both sides of the Galactic centre. Kinematic distances follow the gas velocity through a rotation curve and are less precise than stellar ones.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the pink of ionised hydrogen.
appearance.emphasis: Arm tracer: young, massive star formation that outlines the spiral arms, drawn at full strength.

mapWeight.basis: Hou & Han (2014), Sect. 2.4 and Eq. 2: a weight for the kind of tracer, times 0.5/σ in each disc axis (1 when σ < 0.5 kpc) for a kinematic distance, with σ from a ±7 km/s velocity uncertainty through a flat rotation curve (R0 = 8.3 kpc, Θ0 = 239 km/s, their adopted set). No radio flux in this table: 0.1, the paper's weight for an HII region without one. Kinematic where the distance method ends in /Kin.
